Date: 2026-03-24
RE: Appeal of the denial of laparoscopic sleeve gastrectomy, claim SYN-CLM-500126 (SYNTHETIC CASE)
Patient: Morgan Notaperson | Member ID: SYN-MBR-400126 | DOB: 1979-08-09
Requested service: CPT 43775 | Diagnosis: ICD-10 E66.01

## Response to denial reason
Thank you for taking another look at this request. Your letter of 2026-03-10 denied the sleeve gastrectomy under SYN-D02 because SYN-LCD-2026-C3, the preoperative psychological evaluation, was not documented. It was done: on 2026-02-20 a licensed psychologist completed the evaluation, found no contraindication to surgery and cleared the patient. The report was not attached to the original request and is enclosed now.

## Clinical summary
- BMI 42.3 with type 2 diabetes on metformin and obstructive sleep apnea on CPAP (2025-07-14).
- Completed 6 monthly visits in a dietitian-supervised weight management program between 2025-08-04 and 2026-02-09; weight down from 121 kg to 117 kg.
- Licensed psychologist found no contraindication to surgery and cleared the patient (2026-02-20).

## Policy basis
SYN-LCD-2026 (Bariatric surgery for severe obesity) sets three criteria, SYN-LCD-2026-C1 through SYN-LCD-2026-C3, and the chart meets all three. Please overturn the denial and authorize the procedure.

## Enclosures
- Psychological evaluation report dated 2026-02-20
- Weight management program notes dated 2025-08-04 through 2026-02-09
- Copy of the denial letter dated 2026-03-10

Sincerely,
Dr. Sam Placeholderova, NPI SYN-0000 (synthetic)

- Psychology screening note dated 2026-01-28
- Pain clinic notes dated 2025-04-02 through 2026-01-28

Patient: Sasha Mockridge | Member ID: SYN-MBR-400130 | DOB: 1968-09-22
Requested service: CPT 43235 | Diagnosis: ICD-10 R13.10

## Response to denial reason
Your letter of 2026-03-30 denied the endoscopy under SYN-D02, stating that SYN-LCD-2031-C2 was not met because a trial of twice-daily proton pump inhibitor therapy was not documented. The chart documents it: omeprazole 20 mg twice daily was started on 2026-01-12, and after 9 weeks of it food still sticks several times a week. The medication list and both clinic notes are enclosed.

- Heartburn and food sticking in the lower chest for 2 months; no weight loss (2026-01-12).

SYN-LCD-2031 (Upper endoscopy for dysphagia and reflux) governs this request. SYN-LCD-2031-C1 and SYN-LCD-2031-C2 are met, and we ask that you overturn the denial and authorize the endoscopy.

## Enclosures
- Clinic notes dated 2026-01-12 and 2026-03-16
- Medication list showing omeprazole 20 mg twice daily since 2026-01-12
- Copy of the denial letter dated 2026-03-30
